description: Both filters blank by the SPACES route, and the three-step message overwrite that decides which complaint survives. 2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS sets INPUT-OK, FLG-CARDFILTER-ISVALID and FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID at :610-612, then :615-627 turns eleven typed blanks into CC-ACCT-ID LOW-VALUES and sixteen into CC-CARD-NUM LOW-VALUES. Step one: 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT sets FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK at :648, matches the not-supplied test at :651-653 on its LOW-VALUES disjunct, sets INPUT-ERROR and FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK, finds WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF still true from :264 and so claims the one message slot with the account prompt WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT declares at :138-139, zeroes CDEMO-ACCT-ID at :659 and leaves at :660. Step two: 2220-EDIT-CARD repeats that shape, but its IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :696 now fails, so FLG-CARDFILTER-BLANK is set while WS-PROMPT-FOR-CARD at :140-141 is never set - the flag survives and only the message is suppressed. Step three: the cross-field edit at :637-640 carries no message guard at all and overwrites whatever step one left, so the line that reaches the screen is 'No input received', 17 characters in WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) and 17 then 63 spaces once :494 moves it into ERRMSGO PIC X(80). Neither of the other two texts is written anywhere in this case, and that ordering is exactly what gate G30 protects. INPUT-ERROR at :360 then sends the map and goes to COMMON-RETURN, so 9000-READ-DATA is never reached, no CARDDAT read is issued, and the seeded rows are asserted byte for byte as seeded. Both flags are BLANK rather than NOT-OK - SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK replaced the earlier setting on the same one-byte field, '0' NOT-OK, '1' ISVALID, ' ' BLANK at :55-62 - so the colour guards at :533-539 are false and :541-551 fires instead, moving an asterisk over the LOW-VALUES that 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS wrote into ACCTSIDO and CARDSIDO and DFHRED into both colours, gated on CDEMO-PGM-REENTER. MOVE '*' space-fills its X(11) and X(16) receivers rather than leaving LOW-VALUES behind, because a one-character literal moved to an alphanumeric item pads on the right. COCRDSLC copies no CSSETATY: it re-implements that highlight inline and gates the BLANK path on re-entry while leaving the NOT-OK path ungated, so this case owns the gated side of gate G38 and the NOT-OK cases own the other - the two must not be flattened together. The cursor EVALUATE at :515-524 is ordered and arm one wins on its second condition, FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK, so ACCTSIDL takes the -1 before the card arm is considered. The turn arrives from the main menu with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT 1, which makes the second conjunct of :269-270 false and keeps the passed area rather than initialising it, and it arrives carrying account 50, which is what makes the :659 zeroing observable in the returned context; the carried card number is already zero because the blank path value projects as zero before any arm is chosen. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:16:00, so CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are literals rather than today. Gates G32, G35 and G39 have no site here: every GO TO in this program is a forward early exit or the shared COMMON-RETURN, so there is no backward loop to restructure; there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' anywhere in COCRDSLC, whose abend path is the CICS-native HANDLE ABEND at :250-252 into ABEND ABCODE('9999'); and COCRDSL declares no PAGENO. The class is called CardSelectController because the migration plan names it so, while the source Function header, README.md:220 and CARDDEMO.CSD:220 DESCRIPTION(VIEW CARD DETAIL) all call it a card detail view - honoured verbatim per rule R1 and documented rather than corrected per practice B4. Every expected value here was derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl against the app/cpy-bms/COCRDSL.CPY widths, the app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy record layout, app/bms/COCRDSL.bms and the real US-ASCII fixture; none of it was captured from a running COBOL program, because this environment cannot run one.
